hotspots.title: Javier Milei’s export tax cuts spark debate
hotspots.blurb: Argentine President Javier Milei announced significant reductions in export taxes for wheat, barley, and soybeans, aiming to boost agricultural production. The move has drawn mixed reactions from farmers, industry leaders, and political opponents, with some praising the relief while others demand further reforms.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-stakes economic framing and polarized reactions from key stakeholders, amplifying both support and criticism of Milei’s libertarian policies.

hotspots.title: La Libertad Avanza internal power struggles
hotspots.blurb: Internal conflicts within Argentina’s ruling La Libertad Avanza party have intensified, with factions led by President Javier Milei’s sister Karina and advisor Santiago Caputo clashing over policy direction and influence. The disputes have spilled into public view, undermining the government’s cohesion and public image.
hotspots.affect: This remains a dominant theme due to its moral charge and the perceived threat to the government’s stability, fueling both internal and external scrutiny.

hotspots.title: Trump deploys 5,000 troops to Poland
hotspots.blurb: Former U.S. President Donald Trump announced the deployment of 5,000 additional troops to Poland, reversing earlier plans to reduce U.S. military presence in Europe. The decision, linked to Poland’s recent election of President Karol Nawrocki, has sparked reactions from NATO allies and domestic critics.
hotspots.affect: This story dominates due to its geopolitical implications and the polarized reactions it has elicited, framing it as a major shift in U.S. foreign policy under Trump.

hotspots.title: AfD’s poll surge and leadership ambitions
hotspots.blurb: Germany’s far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) continues to lead in polls, particularly in Saxony-Anhalt, where it risks securing an absolute majority. The party’s rise has sparked debates about its extremist ties, potential governance changes, and the response from mainstream parties.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its high affective investment, with alarmist framing around the AfD’s extremist ties and the potential for far-reaching governance changes in Germany.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen’s legal and political battles
hotspots.blurb: Marine Le Pen, leader of France’s far-right Rassemblement National (RN), faces legal challenges and internal party tensions ahead of the 2027 presidential election. Her responses to controversies, including the Patrick Bruel scandal and EU policy disputes, have intensified scrutiny of her leadership and the RN’s future direction.
hotspots.affect: This story is charged due to its moral and legal dimensions, with Le Pen’s reactions to scandals and policy disputes amplifying public and media attention.
